english.title: Alter, suppress or destroy document required under section 37
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally

(A)_[altered]_
(B)_[suppressed]_
(C)_[destroyed]_

a document, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..), which you had been required to produce by a notice under section 37 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014
english.legislation: Contrary to section 38(4) and (5) of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014.
